challenge.name: 1 · First Cut
challenge.description: Every motor starts at 90°. One X-axis command makes the first cut.

challenge.name: 2 · Sweep Further
challenge.description: Start from the same all-90° Home and extend the X sweep by ten degrees.

challenge.name: 3 · Ten-Voxel Sweep
challenge.description: A five-degree change reaches a complete ten-voxel band.

challenge.name: 4 · Find the Edge
challenge.description: One final boundary voxel sits beyond the ten-voxel band.

challenge.name: 5 · Elbow Band
challenge.description: Use Z · Elbow to select a lower three-voxel band before sweeping.

challenge.name: 6 · Wrist Band
challenge.description: Use B · Wrist to select the upper three-voxel band.

challenge.name: 7 · Stop the Lower Band
challenge.description: The lower band is narrow; the X endpoint decides whether two or three voxels come off.

challenge.name: 8 · Two Working Bands
challenge.description: Combine the lower Z band and upper B band from one all-90° Home.
